feature1.prompt: The issue arises when QuerySet.none() on a combined query returns all results, which is not the expected behavior. In forms that use a union of querysets, an empty submission should result in no objects being added. The problem seems to be related to how the combined query components are duplicated during the cloning process of a query object. The fix should ensure that when a query is cloned, all its combined query parts are correctly replicated so that later operations (such as none()) behave as intended.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature focuses on the cloning logic of queries. The implementation should update the clone() method to properly duplicate the 'combined_queries' attribute. Use a tuple comprehension to iterate over self.combined_queries and call clone() on each individual query. Make sure that the cloned object receives its own independent copy so that later modifications do not affect the original state.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/db/models/sql/query.py – Locate the clone(self) method (around line 305) and add the cloning of combined_queries with: obj.combined_queries = tuple(query.clone() for query in self.combined_queries)

feature2.prompt: When using a union() of querysets in a ModelMultipleChoiceField, the expected behavior is that QuerySet.none() should return an empty result when no items are selected. However, the current situation results in all matching objects being returned. The fix must ensure that the mechanism which sets a query to empty effectively resets all its parts, including any combined queries. This adjustment is critical to prevent the unintended addition of objects when an empty form is submitted.
feature2.hint_texts: This feature targets the emptying logic of combined queries. The implementation should modify the set_empty() method to iterate over the combined_queries and call set_empty() on each. This ensures that the empty state cascades to all parts of the combined query. Also, update the corresponding tests to verify that the empty state is correctly enforced when using union-based queries.
feature2.entrypoint: File: django/db/models/sql/query.py – Locate the set_empty(self) method (around line 1778) and add a loop to call set_empty() on each query in self.combined_queries. Also, review tests in tests/queries/test_qs_combinators.py for the new test case 'test_union_none'.
